Committee: Economic Development and Tourism
Sponsor: Rafferty
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 04/21/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 627 as amended and reported by the Committee on Economic Development and Tourism would increase the administrative obligations of the Alcoholic Beverage Control (ABC) Board to require the board to establish and issue licenses to food trucks in Class 1 municipalities to sell alcoholic beverages for off-premises consumption. This increase in obligations could by offset, wholly or in part, by certain license fees collected and retained by the board. This bill could also increase receipts to the State General Fund up to $150 for each food truck license fee collected due to the provisions of this bill, in addition to any other applicable application or renewal fee.
Becky Nordgren, Chair
Economic Development and Tourism
